fruits.extendedStory: Friedrich von Schmidt drew the plans. He worked in the Gothic Revival. That style borrows the pointed arches and carved stone of the Middle Ages and builds them new. Work here began in 1870. So the carving you are looking at is a nineteenth century hand copying a medieval one. Look closely and you can see two ages sitting in the same wall.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Pläne zeichnete Friedrich von Schmidt. Er arbeitete in der Neugotik. Dieser Stil borgt sich die Spitzbögen und das gehauene Steinwerk des Mittelalters und baut sie neu. Hier begann die Arbeit 1870. Das Steinwerk vor dir ist also eine Hand des neunzehnten Jahrhunderts, die eine mittelalterliche nachahmt. Schau genau hin, dann stecken zwei Zeitalter in derselben Wand.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Friedrich von Schmidt drew the plans. He worked in the Gothic Revival. That style borrows the pointed arches and carved stone of the Middle Ages and builds them new. Work here began in 1870. So the carving you are looking at is a nineteenth century hand copying a medieval one. Look closely and you can see two ages sitting in the same wall.

localizedStory.de: Am Ende des Weges steht die Grabkapelle der Schwarzenbergs, begonnen 1870.
localizedStory.en: At the end of the path stands the Schwarzenberg family chapel, begun in 1870.

fruits.name: Schwarzenberská hrobka
fruits.story: At the end of the path stands the Schwarzenberg family chapel, begun in 1870.

fruits.extendedStory: A manor court stood on this ground before any of it. It was rebuilt in stone, and that small castle appears in writing in 1374. Fire took it in 1562. Vilém of Rožmberk then hired the builder Antonín Ericer to raise a Renaissance chateau in the Italian fashion. A large part of the house is now the State Regional Archive. The Rožmberk family papers are still kept in the building that family rebuilt.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Vor alldem stand hier ein Herrenhof. Man baute ihn in Stein um, und diese kleine Burg taucht 1374 in den Urkunden auf. 1562 brannte sie ab. Vilém von Rožmberk holte danach den Baumeister Antonín Ericer. Der machte daraus ein Renaissanceschloss nach italienischer Mode. Heute sitzt in einem großen Teil des Hauses das Staatliche Gebietsarchiv. Die Papiere der Rožmberks liegen noch immer in dem Haus, das diese Familie umbauen ließ.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A manor court stood on this ground before any of it. It was rebuilt in stone, and that small castle appears in writing in 1374. Fire took it in 1562. Vilém of Rožmberk then hired the builder Antonín Ericer to raise a Renaissance chateau in the Italian fashion. A large part of the house is now the State Regional Archive. The Rožmberk family papers are still kept in the building that family rebuilt.

localizedStory.de: Vok von Rožmberk hätte auf jedem Familiengut wohnen können. 1479 wählte er dieses hier.
localizedStory.en: Vok of Rožmberk could have lived on any estate his family owned. In 1479 he picked this one.

fruits.name: zámek Třeboň
fruits.story: Vok of Rožmberk could have lived on any estate his family owned. In 1479 he picked this one.

fruits.extendedStory: Saint Giles is Jiljí in Czech, which is why people here say svatý Jiljí. Work began in 1280, in the age of Gothic building. Gothic is the style of the pointed arch, and the point is not decoration. An arch like that carries the roof down through the pillars. The walls are then free to open into tall windows.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der heilige Ägidius heißt auf Tschechisch Jiljí, deshalb sagt man hier svatý Jiljí. Gebaut wurde ab 1280, in der Zeit der Gotik. Gotisch ist der Stil des Spitzbogens, und die Spitze ist kein Schmuck. So ein Bogen leitet das Dach über die Pfeiler nach unten. Die Wände werden dadurch frei für hohe Fenster.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Saint Giles is Jiljí in Czech, which is why people here say svatý Jiljí. Work began in 1280, in the age of Gothic building. Gothic is the style of the pointed arch, and the point is not decoration. An arch like that carries the roof down through the pillars. The walls are then free to open into tall windows.

localizedStory.de: Zwei Namen über einer Tür. Der heilige Ägidius und Maria als Königin. Beide stehen hier seit 1280.
localizedStory.en: Two names over one door. Saint Giles, and Mary as Queen. Both have stood here since 1280.

fruits.name: svatý Jiljí a Panna Marie Královna
fruits.story: Two names over one door. Saint Giles, and Mary as Queen. Both have stood here since 1280.

fruits.extendedStory: A municipal farmstead stood on this ground before that. It was pulled down to make room for the new building. The town paid for the work itself, then rented the rooms out, so the square became a piece of municipal business. Třeboň still runs from this address today. Its offices sit at number 46 on the square.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Vorher stand hier ein städtischer Hof. Er wurde abgerissen, um Platz für den Neubau zu schaffen. Die Stadt bezahlte die Arbeit selbst und vermietete die Räume dann weiter. So wurde der Platz zu einem Geschäft der Stadt. Třeboň regiert bis heute von dieser Adresse aus. Die Ämter sitzen auf Nummer 46 an diesem Platz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A municipal farmstead stood on this ground before that. It was pulled down to make room for the new building. The town paid for the work itself, then rented the rooms out, so the square became a piece of municipal business. Třeboň still runs from this address today. Its offices sit at number 46 on the square.

localizedStory.de: 1876 baute die Stadt auf diesem Platz eine Kaserne und vermietete sie an die Armee.
localizedStory.en: The town built barracks on this square in 1876 and rented them out to the army.

fruits.name: Palackého náměstí
fruits.story: The town built barracks on this square in 1876 and rented them out to the army.

fruits.extendedStory: The story starts in a newspaper. The Jihočeský obzor told its readers that a Hussite service would be held on Sunday. None had been held in the town since 1620. People came, and a community formed around it. For a while it met in the Měšťanská beseda, a meeting house in town. Then it bought ground and built this chapel, named for Jan Hus. The Evangelical Methodist congregation still gathers here.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Geschichte beginnt in einer Zeitung. Der Jihočeský obzor schrieb, am Sonntag werde ein hussitischer Gottesdienst gefeiert. Seit 1620 hatte es in der Stadt keinen mehr gegeben. Die Leute kamen, und daraus wuchs eine Gemeinde. Eine Zeit lang traf sie sich in der Měšťanská beseda, einem Versammlungshaus in der Stadt. Dann kaufte sie Grund und baute diese Kapelle, benannt nach Jan Hus. Die evangelisch-methodistische Gemeinde trifft sich hier bis heute.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The story starts in a newspaper. The Jihočeský obzor told its readers that a Hussite service would be held on Sunday. None had been held in the town since 1620. People came, and a community formed around it. For a while it met in the Měšťanská beseda, a meeting house in town. Then it bought ground and built this chapel, named for Jan Hus. The Evangelical Methodist congregation still gathers here.

localizedStory.de: Eine Gemeinde ohne eigenes Haus baute sich dieses. Eröffnet wurde es am 1. Mai 1926.
localizedStory.en: A congregation with no building of its own built this one. It opened on 1 May 1926.

fruits.name: Husova kaple
fruits.story: A congregation with no building of its own built this one. It opened on 1 May 1926.

fruits.extendedStory: Those same years brought a far bigger job. The town threw a second wall around itself, one hundred metres outside the old one. That wall carried bastions built for cannon, with a ditch and an earth rampart in front of it. A gate in a ring like that is a checkpoint, not just a doorway. Everything arriving at the square from the east came through here.

localizedExtendedStory.de: In denselben Jahren lief eine viel größere Arbeit. Die Stadt legte einen zweiten Mauerring um sich, hundert Meter außerhalb des alten. Diese Mauer trug Basteien für Kanonen, davor lagen ein Graben und ein Erdwall. Ein Tor in so einem Ring ist eine Kontrolle, nicht bloß eine Tür. Alles, was von Osten zum Platz kam, ging hier durch.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Those same years brought a far bigger job. The town threw a second wall around itself, one hundred metres outside the old one. That wall carried bastions built for cannon, with a ditch and an earth rampart in front of it. A gate in a ring like that is a checkpoint, not just a doorway. Everything arriving at the square from the east came through here.

localizedStory.de: Dieses Tor schließt den Hauptplatz nach Osten ab. Sein Kern entstand zwischen 1525 und 1527.
localizedStory.en: This gate closes the east side of the main square. Its core was built between 1525 and 1527.

fruits.name: Hradecká brána
fruits.story: This gate closes the east side of the main square. Its core was built between 1525 and 1527.

fruits.extendedStory: The fountain kept growing after that. In 1609 the town set a column in its middle, and four stone faces there spout the water. The obelisk above them carries a carved Rožmberk rose. A few steps away stands the Marian column of 1780, a tall pillar with the Virgin Mary on top. Two townspeople, Jan and Alžběta Pils, paid for it. The stonemason Leopold Huber came from České Budějovice to cut it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Brunnen wuchs danach weiter. 1609 setzte die Stadt eine Säule in seine Mitte, und vier steinerne Gesichter speien dort das Wasser. Der Obelisk darüber trägt eine eingemeißelte Rožmberk-Rose. Ein paar Schritte weiter steht die Mariensäule von 1780, ein hoher Pfeiler mit Maria obenauf. Zwei Bürger, Jan und Alžběta Pils, bezahlten sie. Der Steinmetz Leopold Huber kam aus Budweis, um sie zu hauen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The fountain kept growing after that. In 1609 the town set a column in its middle, and four stone faces there spout the water. The obelisk above them carries a carved Rožmberk rose. A few steps away stands the Marian column of 1780, a tall pillar with the Virgin Mary on top. Two townspeople, Jan and Alžběta Pils, paid for it. The stonemason Leopold Huber came from České Budějovice to cut it.

localizedStory.de: Zähl die Seiten des Brunnens in der Mitte. Es sind zehn, 1569 aus Granit gehauen.
localizedStory.en: Count the sides of the fountain in the middle. There are ten, cut from granite in 1569.

fruits.name: Masarykovo náměstí
fruits.story: Count the sides of the fountain in the middle. There are ten, cut from granite in 1569.

fruits.extendedStory: Look at the gate's north face. Pale patterns are scratched into the plaster, a craft called sgraffito. The maker lays light plaster over dark and cuts the top layer away, so the drawing appears. Now walk into the passage and look up. The curved ceiling carries the same work, in rows of little envelope shapes. The gables above the front are shaped in small arcs.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Schau dir die Nordseite des Tores an. Helle Muster sind in den Putz gekratzt, ein Handwerk namens Sgraffito. Man legt hellen Putz über dunklen und schneidet die obere Schicht weg, dann erscheint die Zeichnung. Geh jetzt in die Durchfahrt und schau nach oben. Die gewölbte Decke trägt dieselbe Arbeit, in Reihen kleiner Briefumschläge. Die Giebel über der Front sind in kleinen Bögen geformt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Look at the gate's north face. Pale patterns are scratched into the plaster, a craft called sgraffito. The maker lays light plaster over dark and cuts the top layer away, so the drawing appears. Now walk into the passage and look up. The curved ceiling carries the same work, in rows of little envelope shapes. The gables above the front are shaped in small arcs.

localizedStory.de: Der Platz trägt den Namen von Jan Žižka, und ein Stadttor schließt ihn nach Süden ab.
localizedStory.en: The square carries the name of Jan Žižka, and a town gate still closes its south end.

fruits.name: Žižkovo náměstí
fruits.story: The square carries the name of Jan Žižka, and a town gate still closes its south end.

fruits.extendedStory: Step through and keep going south. The old earth rampart still runs there, on both sides of the road. This gate belongs to the outer belt of walls, raised in the early sixteenth century. Then the water arrived. The dam of the Svět pond was finished in 1573, and the whole ring of defences had to be reworked around it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Geh hindurch und weiter nach Süden. Dort läuft der alte Erdwall noch immer, zu beiden Seiten des Weges. Dieses Tor gehört zum äußeren Mauerring, errichtet im frühen sechzehnten Jahrhundert. Dann kam das Wasser. 1573 war der Damm des Teichs Svět fertig, und der ganze Verteidigungsring musste darum herum umgebaut werden.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Step through and keep going south. The old earth rampart still runs there, on both sides of the road. This gate belongs to the outer belt of walls, raised in the early sixteenth century. Then the water arrived. The dam of the Svět pond was finished in 1573, and the whole ring of defences had to be reworked around it.

localizedStory.de: Der Torbogen hier ist spitz, und die Stadtmauer drängt sich zu beiden Seiten heran.
localizedStory.en: The gateway here is a pointed arch, and the town wall still presses in on both sides of it.

fruits.name: Novohradská brána
fruits.story: The gateway here is a pointed arch, and the town wall still presses in on both sides of it.
